title: My wife and I are in our 70s. Should we move to California and take on a bigger mortgage to be near our kids?
summary: A couple in their 70s living in a low-cost Northwest state is weighing a move to California to be closer to their adult children, but faces the challenge of taking on a larger mortgage in retirement. The decision involves balancing family proximity against significantly higher housing costs and state taxes.
content: “We currently live in a relatively low-cost, lower-tax Northwest state.”

zh.title: 我和妻子都七十多岁了。我们应该搬到加州并承担更大的抵押贷款来靠近我们的孩子吗？

title: Amazon cargo plane sends up billowing cloud of smoke after overrunning runway at Miami airport
summary: An Amazon cargo plane overran its runway at Miami International Airport on Sunday, creating billowing smoke and temporarily disrupting operations at the busy travel hub. No immediate reports of injuries or significant structural damage have been disclosed.
content: An Amazon cargo plane overshot a runway at Miami International Airport on Sunday, pausing flights at the busy travel hub.

title: NFL Commissioner Roger Goodell agrees on a 4-year contract extension

content: The vote is seen as a barometer for Chancellor Friedrich Merz's government, which has tried to chip away at the AfD's popularity.

title: Trump administration makes another appeal to the Supreme Court to allow mail-in ballot restrictions
